plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps both Parties at one month of Fees paid 'without exception', which conflicts with the Excluded Claims regime in 21.3 and is far below a meaningful cap; likely a material deviation. Check 21.2 (consequential carve-out, direct-damage list) and 21.4 as supporting context.

Section 20 heading contains only 20.1, a broad Customer-gives indemnity for 'every claim' relating to use of the Services; no Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity appears. Note the cross-reference in Sec 9.3 to 'Section 20.5', which does not exist — a Vendor indemnity is effectively missing and the Customer indemnity is unbounded.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month, worldwide, all-product non-compete on Customer — squarely prohibited. Sec 12.3 disclaims any such commitment, so flag the direct conflict and target 12.4 for deletion.
Sec 2.2 (first of two clauses numbered 2.2) makes Vendor the sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics — a deviation. Sec 12.3 expressly negates exclusivity; cite the inconsistency.

No MFN obligation running against Customer is apparent; Sec 12.3 affirmatively states no most-favoured-customer commitment was made. Confirm nothing in Sec 7 pricing or Sec 8.3 uplift acts as an MFN before marking absent.

No non-solicit binding Customer located; Sec 12.3 preserves hiring of anyone responding to general recruitment and disclaims any no-hire commitment. Verify Section 12's unlisted subsections (12.1–12.2 not in outline) if present in full text.

Sec 9.4 gives Customer 30-day convenience termination with refunds and denies Vendor a reciprocal right — favourable, do not flag. Cross-check Sec 2.1's take-or-pay with 'no termination rights', which undercuts 9.4; raise that under MINCOMMIT rather than twice here.

Sec 8.2 gives a 30-day non-renewal window plus a 60-day Vendor reminder with deadline extension, and Sec 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice — appears compliant; note fallback posture rather than redlining.
Sec 28.1 selects New York law and 28.2 exclusive New York County courts (no foreign arbitration) — within accepted list; expect compliant. Sec 28.3 escalation is preserved for urgent relief.

Sec 24.1 permits Customer affiliate/successor assignment without consent and 24.4 bars Vendor termination or repricing on our change of control — favourable. Sec 24.2/24.3 constrain Vendor; Sec 13.3 cross-references Section 24 for licence transfer.

Sec 14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data and pre-existing IP; 14.2 assigns Deliverables to Customer on payment; 14.3/14.4 handle Vendor Technology, joint IP and feedback. Sec 15.1 blocks model training and secondary use — direction runs our way, expect compliant.

Sec 13.1 grants a Customer-only, non-transferable licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and excludes Affiliates and contractors — a clear deviation. Sec 13.2 (perpetual affiliate/contractor licence for paid-up material) and 13.3 (limits on revocation) are the internal contradictions and drafting source for the fix.

Sec 22.1 limits Vendor audits to once per 12 months with 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site where practicable and an independent auditor; 22.2 puts costs on Vendor absent a >5% shortfall and bars system access. Expect compliant; Sec 23 records clause may be a related location.

No liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer is evident; Sec 7.3 bars interest on amounts not due and Sec 9.4 termination is penalty-free. Sec 2.1 take-or-pay is the nearest penalty-like exposure but belongs to MINCOMMIT.

Sec 19.2 limits the Deliverable conformity warranty to fifteen days with no correction or refund obligation afterward — likely below the fallback duration. Sec 19.1/19.3 give ongoing services warranties and 19.4 supplies a real re-perform/refund remedy; weigh these before flagging, and note the 19.4 cross-reference to 19.2.
Sec 18.1 sets CGL, workers' comp, employer's liability, E&O and USD 5m cyber cover for the term plus one year; 18.2 adds certificates, primacy and non-limitation of liability. Expect compliant.

Sec 2.1 imposes a USD 2m/year three-year take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights' — a deviation and directly at odds with Sec 9.4 convenience termination and Sec 12.3's no-minimum-volume disclaimer.

Sec 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support — a deviation that contradicts Sec 11.2 (30-day machine-readable return, no hostage for fee disputes) and 11.3 (certified deletion after confirmed return). Sec 10.1/10.2 cover transition period and refunds.
